checks.claim_or_finding: Archivematica transfer identifiers, checksums, supplied checksum verification and original-order METS
checks.judgment: Useful scoped workflow analogy; no desktop dependency or current-release platform suitability claim.

checks.claim_or_finding: Manual normalization filename/one-to-one assumptions and optional event detail
checks.judgment: The outline and one-to-one limitation are documented, but the same source also has normalization.csv for duplicate basename/path relationships. That useful mechanism was omitted; refusal to copy the larger workflow wholesale remains reasonable.

checks.claim_or_finding: BWF MetaEdit metadata tables, structural warnings, selectable rules, CSV/XML export, explicit writes; BWF-only scope
checks.judgment: Product documentation supports the analogy and write caution. XML/structural feature citation is more direct in the independently retrieved product page than the candidate capture set. No all-format parser or tested implementation is selected.

checks.claim_or_finding: Embedded audio-data MD5 differs from whole-file fixity
checks.judgment: The digest concerns data bytes, excluding chunk header/padding and other metadata; its rejection as sole whole-file fixity is applicable.

checks.claim_or_finding: LOC archival preferences do not determine a listening derivative recipe
checks.judgment: The no-recipe inference is sound. S10 is archived 2009 background, not current preference policy; final/map do not disclose that source-date limit.

checks.claim_or_finding: BagIt opaque payload and complete/valid definitions
checks.judgment: Applies to BagIt 1.0 and byte-level package validation, not audio semantics.

checks.claim_or_finding: Complete payload manifest coverage and duplicate entries
checks.judgment: Proposed complete-manifest and duplicate/malformed-entry checks are legitimate requirements; no component is claimed to pass them.

checks.claim_or_finding: Tag-file checksum verification in a conditional BagIt profile
checks.judgment: All listed tag checksums require checking. Tag manifests are excluded from self/cross listing by the RFC; final does not explicitly prescribe a circular manifest.

checks.claim_or_finding: Payload-Oxum is a shortcut, not validity
checks.judgment: Applicable to full reopen assurance; the rejection of Oxum-only validity is correct.

checks.claim_or_finding: RFC algorithm support modality and SHA-512 creation default
checks.judgment: Final line 17 says tools should support both algorithms; RFC uses MUST for support, SHOULD for SHA-512 creation default. Output-manifest choice and implementation capability are distinct. The default correction is right; the support paraphrase is weakened.
checks.applicable_conditions: If an adopter reads should as optional support, a SHA-512-only tool would not satisfy the cited BagIt 1.0 tool requirement. No such tool is chosen; final line 97 still requires RFC 8493 conformance.

checks.claim_or_finding: fetch.txt is allowed by format but excluded by product policy
checks.judgment: Complete-local/offline packaging is a proposed policy, not an asserted prohibition in BagIt. No remote retrieval is performed by the plan.

checks.claim_or_finding: Pinned bagit-python v1.9.0 identity
checks.judgment: Public tag ref resolves to commit 861ddacb339d5b92659f0187a402f501d841abbe, corroborating release and code identity.

checks.claim_or_finding: Bag.validate governing call path and defaults

evidence.range_or_selector: Bag.validate lines 586-604; Bag.__init__/_open lines 280-303,325-371; Bag._load_manifests lines 620-727; Bag._validate_contents lines 778-795; _calc_hashes/_calculate_file_hashes lines 1111-1148

checks.judgment: Code ties the claimed modes to structure, fetch, completeness and file-hash processing. Flags being false are necessary for checksum checks, not a claim that this library is a complete conformance oracle.

checks.claim_or_finding: Same-size mutation passes fast/completeness-only while normal validation expects a failure

evidence.range_or_selector: TestSingleProcessValidation.validate lines 71-73 and test_validate_flipped_bit lines 100-111; test_validate_completeness lines 119-130

checks.judgment: The inspected test assertions support this mode distinction. No tests were run by this review or claimed executed by final.

checks.claim_or_finding: make_bag is an in-place directory rearrangement and writes 0.97

evidence.range_or_selector: make_bag signature lines 141-160, permissions lines 185-208, move/write lines 211-264
